state: Judge a proposed product contract as a design consultant. There is no running Can compiler or shared library, and that development stage must not count against any alternative. In a hypothetical 25-person services department, an employee must nominate an active other reviewer for an expense at an allowed location through a browser or chatbot. The captured CanExpense declaration has reviewer:user on line 11 and a generated create form on line 93. The shared Employees package (lines 6 and 11) makes user identity and scoped work attributes readable to eligible colleagues; it supplies neither an exact name nor title field. The interface rules at DESIGN lines 587, 654-656 permit authorized bounded reference choices, require full opaque identity to disambiguate labels, and do not create account-directory access from a user parameter. They do not otherwise define an explicit directory grant. We have source inspection only, not successful staff trials. A different evaluator handles role eligibility and revoked-reviewer recovery; hold those corrections constant, along with current access, mutation versions, shared browser/MCP behavior and frozen historical claim/decision evidence. Compare each solution for staff task completion, information disclosure, agent edit economy, data transition work and platform upkeep. Unique opaque identifiers have real privacy/identity benefits; names aid recognition but can repeat. Implementation and stewardship costs apply to every option.

reviewer_selection.instructions: Select the next proportionate response to the employee identification problem under the stated conditions. If a comparison needs missing evidence, use unresolved. Classifier confidence cannot establish working usability.

criteria.opaque_ids: Leave account-valued reviewer fields and opaque inputs in place, and supply authorized reviewer IDs through a current steward-maintained work list. No syntax or existing storage changes are needed; extra finding and verification steps and ongoing list updates fall to staff/steward.
criteria.employee_reference: Represent the reviewer with the already supported Employee record type and add an authorized Employee name field. Derive the account used in checks from that record and apply existing reference labels, complete IDs and grants. No general account-directory feature is introduced; the price is a declared migration and revised source, targets, examples and record-version handling while preserving historic actor evidence.
criteria.bounded_directory: Specify a finite user lookup surface, populated only from declared readable employee data, for both interfaces; keep the account type in Expense. Reusable assignment controls and stable account evidence are potential advantages. New static/runtime/UI contract work and explicit disclosure/grant rules are costs; a global directory cannot be assumed.
criteria.unresolved: Clarify permitted directory lookup and conduct a small selection trial before changing the current treatment. This retains the privacy boundary and reduces speculation at the cost of unresolved selection effort and time spent on the trial.
